what_to_detect: A surge-cost cast is a playable candidate because its controller (or a teammate) has cast another spell this turn.
near_miss: A surge-cost candidate is not playable because its controller has cast no other spell this turn (an opponent's spell does not count).
record_fields: acting line of kind Keyword (the keyword's own sidecar line, script API type Keyword)
verdict_bit with fires_when true and no keyword restriction matches nearly every decision record
